findings.detail: Node >=22.19.0 is satisfied; Pi/TUI peer wildcard includes SDK1.2.0, but no runtime qualification exists because the package is not installed.
Published artifact declares dist/index.js and skills directory; the main entry is a regular file in the downloaded tarball.
prepare builds dist, downloads core grammars, sets Git hooks and warms loader caches; native AST-grep dependencies can have their own lifecycle/platform setup. No scripts were executed.

Source contains LSP/tool child-process management, formatter/autofix operations, managed tool installation and GitHub/unpkg grammar/tool downloads. These paths must be disabled or locally stubbed for provider-free checks.
Entry session_start adopts host project trust and declares that untrusted projects disable tool auto-install and LSP spawn. Actual SDK1.2.0 trust-port propagation was not executed.
Tool/lifecycle registrations are present; TUI affordances and late/lazy tool activation need an actual SDK test and must not be assumed to work through this MCP host.

Source tracks diagnostics and session/model-related telemetry and can read/write code and extension-owned caches. Known remote download paths are present; no complete absence of optional outbound telemetry is established.
Real production resolver reports extension_not_installed. Do not silently substitute a scoped fork or install it into global/user Pi state.
Declared Node >=22.5.0 is satisfied; package declares no Pi peer range, so SDK1.2.0 compatibility remains unqualified.
Source-available Elastic-2.0 license, distinct from MIT. No legal compatibility decision is inferred.
Declared build/adapters/pi/extension.js exists. Extension opens a session SQLite database and records prompt/tool-derived events and compaction snapshots in adapter-owned home state.

before_agent_start lazily starts a local MCP server and registers discovered ctx tools. Bootstrap is best effort and failure can degrade to no tools; production admission freezes a composed allowlist earlier, so late registration and activation need explicit compatibility testing.

ctx execution/fetch/index/search tools are more powerful than read-only navigation; package also advertises upgrade and purge. Shell HTTP regex routing is not an OS sandbox or general network authorization layer.
Source distinguishes hasUI false and uses an idle reaper for noninteractive bridge children. No actual SDK/headless run occurred.
postinstall contains a global-install-only repair path for other client plugin registries/settings and cache metadata. No lifecycle script or client registration was executed.
Session usage/event telemetry and persistent local content are present; known fetch and upgrade network paths exist. No package-wide outbound-telemetry absence is claimed.
Real production resolver reports extension_not_installed; no output-volume bottleneck was demonstrated by the current screening, so no quality ablation is selected.
